Name: A Friend For Ariah - Rory Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33473]Rory NPC - a friend for Ariah (Ridgeside Village)[/url] was left unfinished with open permission to continue the project as long as respect for the character's pronouns were kept, and there was interest in their return, so I decided to pick up the project. Artwork for Rory's portraits was done with Poltergeister & Jazzybee's [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdv-creator-masc]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url] while spritework was done by myself. Rory themself was originally created by arcadiabays.



So...meet Rory!

Rory is a non-binary teenager who's been sent to live with the Amethynes by their parents for their studies. Can they help Ariah break out of her shell?

[u]Features:[/u]
-full dialogue
-full schedule
-8 heart events
-optional seasonal outfits
-2 edited Ariah events from RSV + a bonus Ariah event

[u]Gift tastes:[/u]
-Loves: Strange dolls, pickles, pancakes, cookies, pizza, and joja cola
-Likes: juice, coffee, field snack, sunflowers, cave carrots
-Dislikes: diamond, prismatic shard, emerald, aquamarine, topaz, ruby, amethyst
-hates: any alcohol

[u]Heart Events: [/u]

Intro: Enter Ridgeside Village after getting Ariah to 1 heart

2 heart event: Go to Pelican Town on a sunny day between 10 am and 4 pm

4 heart event: Enter the Amethyne Mansion between 8 am and 8 pm. Must also have 4 hearts with Ariah

6 heart event: Go to the Mountain on a rainy day between 10 am and 4 pm

8 heart event: Go to the Mountain on a sunny day between 10 am and 4 pm

This mod will also edit Ariah's 4 heart and 8 heart events, plus add a bonus Ariah scene which can be viewed by going to the second floor of the mansion when both Rory and Ariah are at 7 hearts. 

Rory can usually be found around the mansion, visiting Torts or the mountain lake, or grabbing a bite to eat at Pika or Gus'. Sometimes they can be found at the library too.

Enjoy!
